correctness.summary: The explicit star-coordinate construction gives q+1_{s>=2} factors. Four-point incompatibility forces distinct coordinates for distance-two pairs from different non-singleton parts, and when s>=2 it forces a further coordinate for a singleton pair. A standalone verifier checks 128 connected complete-multipartite types through order 10.

limitations: The full text of Pachter--Sturmfels (2005), Section 3.5, was not inspected and is the principal residual originality risk.
The theorem is restricted to connected complete multipartite graph metrics.
Finite verification covers orders 2 through 10 and is supporting evidence only.
Independent audit has not been performed.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The current 2026 source proves complete bipartite rank two, the perfect-matching-complement rank-half family, K4\e rank two, and the rank-one classification, but does not state the arbitrary complete-multipartite formula. Cartwright--Chan study a different tree-rank notion and explicitly distinguish it from Pachter--Sturmfels. The principal residual risk is Pachter--Sturmfels (2005), Section 3.5, whose full text was not inspected; an equivalent special case there would weaken or eliminate originality.

review_statement: Same-model review: passed. Independent audit: not yet performed.

value.summary: The theorem exactly determines a broad natural graph class, unifies several separate examples in the newest paper, and gives the full fixed-order spectrum of ranks among connected complete multipartite graphs.
